2608.02712.title: Don't Regenerate, Debug: A Domain-Specific Agent for Repairing Near-Miss Hardware Operators
2608.02712.paper_summary: Kernel generation for hardware accelerators such as GPUs and NPUs has become a proving ground for large language models (LLMs), and state-of-the-art systems raise correctness through pipelines that couple LLMs with agentic reinforcement learning and evolutionary search. Such pipelines generate, compile, and execute large numbers of candidate kernels, discarding most of them and forgoing the opportunity to distill failures into reusable knowledge. Many discarded candidates are near-miss operators that compile and run but fail numerical validation; each embodies genuine domain knowledge and a nontrivial investment in LLM inference, cross-compilation, and hardware execution. We argue for a paradigm shift: rather than regenerate, debug. Debugging is far more constrained than generating from scratch: the search space is small and feedback is dense. We present a domain-specific debug agent that addresses three core challenges in autonomous repair: mitigating knowledge scarcity through retrieved patterns and diagnostic instrumentation, ensuring integrity through anti-cheat detection and full-coverage evaluation, and controlling cost via convergence guards and bounded iteration. Debugging serves two complementary roles: it extends the capability frontier by recovering operators that repeated regeneration fails to produce, and it lowers cost per deliverable operator. Debug Pass@1 achieves 66.7% versus Regenerate Avg Pass@1's 25.9% and Regenerate Pass@3's 40.7%, while consuming 92.8% fewer tokens per success than three-trial regeneration. Component ablations show that the knowledge base drives recovery, while integrity gates reject 12.5-33.3% of the successes the workflow itself accepted.
2608.02712.paper_summary_zh: 硬體加速器（如 GPU 和 NPU）的內核生成已成為大型語言模型（LLMs）的試驗場，最先進的系統通過將 LLM 與自主強化學習和進化搜索相結合的管道提高正確性。這些管道生成、編譯並執行大量候選內核，丟棄大多數，放棄將失敗提煉為可重用知識的機會。許多被丟棄的候選項是接近成功的運算符，它們可以編譯和運行，但未能通過數值驗證；每個都體現了真實的領域知識以及在 LLM 推理、交叉編譯和硬體執行上的非平凡投資。我們主張進行範式轉變：與其重新生成，不如進行除錯。除錯的約束遠比從頭生成要小：搜索空間較小，反饋密集。我們提出了一種特定領域的除錯代理，解決自主修復中的三個核心挑戰：通過檢索模式和診斷工具減輕知識稀缺，通過反作弊檢測和全面評估確保完整性，以及通過收斂保護和有界迭代控制成本。除錯有兩個互補的角色：它通過恢復重複生成未能產生的運算符來擴展能力邊界，並降低每個可交付運算符的成本。Debug Pass@1 達到 66.7%，而 Regenerate Avg Pass@1 為 25.9%，Regenerate Pass@3 為 40.7%，同時每次成功消耗的標記比三次嘗試的重新生成少 92.8%。組件消融顯示知識庫驅動恢復，而完整性閘則拒絕了工作流程本身接受的 12.5-33.3% 的成功案例。
